label: Bible Study
prompt: For where your _____ is, there will your heart be also.
verse: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
note: Follow the money and you'll find the heart — Jesus said it first.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Draw _____ to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
verse: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.
note: Draw nigh, and He draws nigh — the shortest distance in the Bible is one step toward God.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a _____ out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
verse: And when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks, and laid them on the fire, there came a viper out of the heat, and fastened on his hand.
note: Shipwrecked on Malta, Paul gathers firewood and a viper latches on — he shakes it into the fire, unharmed.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
verse: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of his saints.
note: God doesn't treat his people's deaths as statistics — each one is costly in his sight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they _____ him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
verse: And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death.
note: 'By the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony' — the classic testimony-service text.
